author: wtn
body:
As discussed in #12560, a thread that another thread starts goes to the local queue of that thread's worker, and its first run pins it there. The pool does not grow for it, so the threads one thread starts share one worker. At 353f846423216acd772297462b4ffe4bcc879cdf, one thread starts 8 CPU-bound threads (the program in #12560, with ITER=300000000 on macOS arm64, 15 cores):

```
N=1:  0.96 to 1.07 s
N=8:  7.90 to 8.37 s
N=4, ITER=30000000:  0.48 s (N=1: 0.12 s)
```

With this change, thread_spawn places such a thread with `sched_place_unstarted(sp_worker_id, t)`, as it places a thread main starts: on the helper with the fewest pinned threads, adding a helper while the count allows. Where the spawner's worker is as good as any, the thread stays in its local queue as before. The pinning the per-worker string heap needs is set at the first run, so it holds. With 8 threads the program takes 0.99 to 1.05 s, the time of one thread, and with 4 threads at ITER=30000000 it takes 0.12 s. docs/thread.md says a thread stays on the worker it first ran on, not the one that started it.

sched_place_unstarted now skips a helper that is in a blocking native call, where a thread placed there could not run. Main's own spawns go through the same function and get the same guard; when no helper is left to choose, the thread stays unstarted in its spawner's local queue (main's in the global queue), where a steal or main's stranded sweep can still take it.

The new test checks that two threads one thread starts run at the same time. On master such a thread also runs elsewhere when an idle helper steals it before its first run, which happens on a lightly loaded machine, so master passes the test there and fails it under load; the test pins the placement under load.

Please note one case, the accepted cost: a thread that starts short-lived threads and joins them wakes another worker for each one. A thread that starts 20,000 threads and takes each one's value takes 0.026 s at 353f846423216acd772297462b4ffe4bcc879cdf and 0.17 to 0.23 s with this change, about the 0.11 to 0.30 s the same loop takes in main. Under `SPINEL_WORKERS=2` it is unchanged (0.021 to 0.031 s). The timings were taken with a load average of 10 to 19 from other jobs on the machine.

## `make gate` (on this branch merged with master at 6623266c809849e4b243708ccc1f6c971079b8f8, linux aarch64 gcc-14.2.0)

```
scale-test: open method history work at 4x the histories is 5.92x (limit 6.50)
scale-test: visibility face work at 2x the landing classes is 1.98x (limit 2.20)
scale-test: inherited class method lookup work at 4x the classes is 3.98x (limit 4.40)
Tests: 12307 pass, 0 fail, 0 error
gate: ALL GREEN
```

- [x] New tests have `.expected` files that match CRuby 4.0 run with `--enable-frozen-string-literal` (the new test is `# spinel: not-cruby`: CRuby's GVL runs one thread at a time)
- [x] Values past 2^31 are marked `# spinel: int64` (none)
- [x] If optcarrot's generated C changed: callgrind numbers, checksum 59662 (no change to generated C)
- [x] Depends on: none

author: bwiemz
body:
A follow-up to #244: the owner's answers to two of its questions.

## The display's weight

The exact display of large parts was heavy. The Moon buggy drew 329k triangles, and its part-file cache grew from 5.8 to 26.5 MB.

Measurement showed the cause was the absolute 0.1 mm chord tolerance on its 254 mm wheels. The 0.35 rad angle limit was not the cause, as #244 had said; that line in the spec is corrected here. Following the owner's decision:

- **Angle:** the display's angle limit is now 0.5 rad, about 26 chords a turn, because the mesher steps at half the angle.
- **Tolerance:** the display's chord tolerance is part-relative: `max(0.1, 1.5e-4 × the part's diagonal)`. Parts under about 667 mm across are unchanged by it.
- **Where it applies:**
  - the exact counterpart's mesh, and so the part-file cache;
  - the window's faceted mesh;
  - GLB export;
  - section views (they take the display's default).
- **Unchanged:** STL export and hidden-line classification keep 0.1, and Booleans and interference keep the read point's 0.35 rad. Drawings are made from the faceted part, so the new angle does not reach them.

| Part | Across (mm) | Triangles | Cache |
|---|---|---|---|
| Moon buggy | 4488 | 329,308 → 49,462 | 26.5 → 3.9 MB |
| Pro/E | 1235 | 76,238 → 43,430 | 7.9 → 4.7 MB |
| IronCAD | 1263 | 41,242 → 20,892 | 3.9 → 2.1 MB |
| IRNAS | 112 | 10,000 → 5,568 (angle only) | 1.3 → 0.8 MB |

## STEP written by Horizon before the exact kernel

A short probe confirmed the cause stage 2 measured. A hand-made cylinder in the old writer's form (r 10, h 20) is refused with stage 2's message ("stands 0.0482 off its face's surface"). Its rims lie outside its caps' bilinear B-spline patches, which the old writer sized to the 32-gon. Growing the patch by 1% makes it read exact, which rules out a seam or periodic-loop problem.

Reading these files would take one of three things:
- recognising the patch as a plane, which goal 7 forbids for imported B-splines;
- extending a patch past its knot domain;
- loosening the limit.

None is a clean reader fix, so per the owner's rule this is documented in CHANGELOG.md as a pre-exact-kernel export break. The part file still opens and exports again cleanly.

## Tests

- New tests:
  - the display's angle (26 against 36 chords);
  - a large part meshed to its size, in SolidTessellator and the exact counterpart;
  - a watertight exact display mesh;
  - a glTF export pinned to the display's mesh.
- Re-baselined: `StepFidelityTest.AFaceWithARoundHoleIsDrawnWithTheHole`. Its area allowance now comes from the display's angle.
- The full suite passes locally (2897/2897), and clang-format-15 is clean.
- An independent code review found no Critical or Important issues. Its four minor findings are fixed in bfe8615e.

author: leenusdarnal
body:
## Summary

Adds a local N-up PDF layout workflow for arranging multiple source pages on print-sized sheets.

### Included
- 1, 2, 4, 6, 9, and 16 pages per sheet.
- Custom page ranges with duplicate and bounds validation.
- A4, US Letter, and US Legal output paper.
- Automatic, portrait, and landscape orientation.
- Configurable outer margins and inter-page gutters.
- Row-first and column-first reading order.
- Optional cell borders and original page-number labels.
- Responsive layout preview, progress feedback, and local PDF download.
- Vector page-form embedding; source PDF bytes are not modified.
- Unit and Playwright browser regression tests.
- README and project tracker updates.

### Guardrails / limitations
- 150 MB source-file limit and 500 selected-page limit.
- Password-protected or malformed PDFs are rejected with a readable error.
- Form widgets, links, digital signatures, and interactive annotations may not be retained by page-form embedding.
- Independent visual inspection in a separate PDF viewer remains part of final fidelity QA.

### Verification
CI will run Svelte/TypeScript checks, unit tests, Playwright Chromium regression tests, and the production build.

This PR is intentionally stacked on PR #29 (feat/watermarks-page-numbers). Merge order remains #27 → #28 → #29 → this PR.

author: misko19
body:
Exhausted campaign PR recovery currently has no supported owner admission path. Add a human-only control-plane API to inspect an exact repair record and admit 1–4 additional instructions, retaining cumulative attempts and a durable, idempotent authorization receipt. Refs #4950.

The API binds admission to current campaign scope, policy, owner, observed PR head, original review requester and preserved worktree. Restoration remains a separate human action. Revocation and incompatible changes fence unused allowance; all existing budgets, review, CI and merge gates remain in force. No automatic extension requests or new agent tool are introduced.

Documented conservative eligibility: PR check repairs/rereviews only, one proven original review requester, fresh forge facts, preserved linked worktree, and no unrelated dispatch fence. Legacy fenced resources remain blocked when their fence cannot be proven to be exhaustion alone. This delivers an API workflow; no browser UI changes.

Validation: control-plane typecheck; 130 recovery store/integration tests passed; targeted owner API test passed after extra stale/owner validation assertions. Synthetic fixtures prove retained attempts, original requester/worktree and review epoch/round/finding history, duplicate and lost-response reconciliation, revoked/stale authority, denial/access/lifecycle changes and renewed exhaustion. No live recovery state, historical workers, hosting stack or other PR was modified.

author: turtton
body:
## 問題
自動 archive は未回答の質問と、閉じられていない managed lane (attached / summary) があるスレッドを保留する。溜まった既存分を一度だけ片付ける手段が無い。

## 変更後の挙動
`evorch maintenance cleanup-archive-blockers`（オフライン専用・一回限り）。
- **preview**（既定、読み取り専用）: 対象の質問・lane の全件、除外と理由、処理不能、`apply_allowed`、obsolete 化する通知数、Closed 通知の宛先 lead 数、`source_image_sha256` / 独立した `target_manifest_sha256` / `plan_hash` を JSON で出力。
- **apply**: `--apply --plan <preview.json> --backup <path>`。config の launch/lifetime lock・DB 保守 lease・SQLite 排他を保持し、WAL 空・main DB の SHA 一致・manifest 一致を確認、検証済み backup の後に **単一 transaction** で
  - pending 質問 → 新しい終端状態 **cancelled**（回答・回答元・承認・review evidence を作らない）。同 transaction でその質問の pending な Question 通知を obsolete 化（lead を起こさない）。
  - attached/summary の open lane → 既存 close 遷移（`close_lane_in`）で **discarded**（closer = `maintenance_cli`）。
  - 完了 receipt（hash・件数・時刻のみ、immutable、retention catalog は `Keep`）。
- 再実行は `already_applied`（receipt 一致）／同条件なら適用／それ以外は無変更で拒否の 3 分岐のみ。非空 WAL は常に拒否し、CLI は回復も checkpoint 先行もしない。
- 現行 schema のみ（migration しない。v76 は通常起動が適用）。run の停止・runtime 起動・thread の直接 archive/delete はしない。

## lane 判断（docs の同梱）
`docs/storage-maintenance.md` は PR1 (#808) の先例に従い、親 lane の判断として同じ PR に含める。

## PR2a との関係（C-X2）
PR2a (#810) は先に main へマージ済み（9f116ee2、migration 追加なし）。本 PR を origin/main へ rebase し、PR2a の DB/root writer 専用 lease（`maintenance/writer_leases.rs`）を apply の排他証明に統合した: `exclusive_writer_proof` が DB（`<db>.writer-lock`）→ root（`<ownership root>/.ownership-writer-lock`）の順に排他・非待機で取得し、core・legacy embedded writer・同じ ownership root を共有する別 DB の core がいれば無変更で拒否する（root ディレクトリが無ければ作成して root lease を実際に取得し、apply 終了まで保持。作成・取得できなければ拒否。preview は何も作らない）。テスト `a_running_writer_of_either_lease_refuses_apply_and_changes_nothing`。migration は v76 のまま（衝突なし）。

## tool 説明・cache 境界（C-C1）
`meta/specs.rs` の `user_answers` と `subagent_questions` の説明 2 件だけを変更（「32 most recent answered」→「answered または cancelled」、`cancelled:true` の説明）。入力 schema・tool の集合/順序は不変。build 更新時の **tools-only 境界**として扱う（履歴・system・model/settings・ToolResult・cache affinity は不変）。`fixtures/waits-main-*` は凍結された過去履歴なので変更しない。

## pending 判定箇所の分類（C-Q4）
非テストコードの `answer.is_none()/is_some()`、`answered=0/1` を走査して分類。

| 分類 | 箇所 |
|---|---|
| **pending**（未回答かつ未取消） | runtime: `agent_loop/questions.rs`（blocking gate）, `runtime/questions.rs`（`wait_or_blocked_on_user`, `pending_direct_child_questions`, `has_pending_user_questions`, `has_unanswered_questions`）, `meta/runs/waiting.rs`・`waiting/events.rs`（pending_question・attention・needs_user_input）, `escalation/prompt.rs`（継承質問）。storage: `user_questions.rs`（`requester_question_count`, `pending`, `bind` の容量）, `lane_management/effects.rs`, `lane_control/attention.rs`・`verification.rs`（open_question_count）, `lane_delivery.rs`（lead 質問一覧）, `thread_retention/decision.rs` `sql::QUESTIONS`。host: `invocations.rs`（blocked_on_user）, `projection.rs`（pending_only・snapshot）, `ingress/namespaces/questions.rs`（revision 検査）, `queries/models.rs`。eval/cli: `eval/driver.rs`・`conversation.rs`, `evorch/cli/run.rs`。gui: `core_client/{notifications,conversation,features/workspace/tree}.rs`, `app/{questions,escalation,branching,system_notifications}.rs`, `model/{notifications,lane_attention}.rs`。web: `store.js`（pendingQuestions・leadRoutedQuestions）, `cards.js`（入力無効化）。 |
| **answered**（実回答のみ） | runtime: `agent_loop/questions.rs`（回答注入・delivered ids。`answer_message()` は `Option`）, `meta/runs/waiting/events.rs`（answers）, `runtime/questions.rs`（`answer_is_in_history`、同一回答の idempotent 判定）, `runtime/questions/forwarding.rs`, `routing.rs`（回答後の配信）, `meta/lanes.rs`（answer_saved）, `meta/threads/read.rs`（answer 本文）。storage: `user_questions.rs`（answer/FirstOnly）, `lane_delivery.rs`・`lane_control/forward.rs`（回答／forward／reroute）, `reclaim.rs`（`q.answered=1` の routing 保持＝実回答のみ）。host: `commands/question.rs`（回答済みの再回答）, `queries/models.rs`（回答表示）。 |
| **terminal**（answered または cancelled） | runtime: `meta/questions.rs`（listing: 全 Pending ＋直近 32 Terminal）, `runtime/questions/delivery.rs`（子質問の親通知の早期 return）, `runtime/questions.rs`（`inherit_user_questions` の carry）。gui: `app/questions.rs`（fold: pending 以外は除去）, `model/transcript*.rs`（取消の表示）。eval: `driver.rs`（mark_answered / is_answered）。 |
| **変更不要** | 回答本文の表示・保存（`answer` を Option として読むだけ）、`recipient_run_ids` による継承、`lane_question_routes` の routing revision、`thread_retention/reclaim.rs` の routing 回収条件（実回答か否かだけを見る）、通知の Answer 生成（Answered 以外は生成されない）、provider 履歴（既送信 ToolResult は書き換えない）。 |

追加の遷移・拒否: `StorageError::QuestionCancelled` / `AnswerQuestionError::Cancelled` / host の Conflict。idempotent receipt の早期 return より前に終端性を検査（`user_questions::answer_checked`, `lane_control/forward.rs`, `lane_delivery.rs`）。

## 検証
- storage: `cargo nextest run -p storage -p event-bus -p core-instance` 1775 passed（cleanup 19 件、migration v76、`decision_tests` の EXPLAIN／index inventory を含む）。
- runtime: `offline_cancelled_question_neither_blocks_finish_nor_is_injected_as_an_answer`（apply → 再起動 → restore → finish、回答注入なし、取消後の回答拒否）、`a_cancelled_question_does_not_wake_the_lead_after_a_restart`（C-Q7: 対照で wake/provider request が出る状況で、apply 後は lead の claim・restore・provider request が 0）。
- evorch: `maintenance_e2e` の引数解析テスト（apply は plan と backup 必須、custom `--db` は `--config-dir` 必須）。
- `cargo clippy --all-targets -D warnings`・`cargo fmt` 通過。
- ローカル sandbox は process guard bundle・product artifact が無く、バイナリを起動する統合テスト群は環境要因で失敗する。**これらは CI で確認する。**

## 未検証
- 実データ（`~/.config/evorch`）には一切触れていない。実 DB のサイズ・件数・所要時間は未計測。
- GUI / Web の表示は consumer の条件変更とコンパイル・既存テストまで（目視確認なし）。

## レビュー指摘への対応（M1〜M5）
- M1: sidebar の `run_ids` 欠落・`null` は処理不能（`sidebar.rs`）。テスト 2 ケース追加。
- M2: commit 後の checkpoint の全エラー（busy・SQL/I/O）を「COMMITTED・checkpoint 未完了」として報告し、同じ plan で `already_applied` を確認する手順を返す。故障注入 `Fault::Checkpoint` のテスト追加。
- M3: source の空き容量検査を backup 新規作成・再利用の共通経路へ移動（`backup.rs`）。
- M4: `recovery_activation_cache/question_listing_schema.rs` を追加。旧 `user_answers`/`subagent_questions` 説明（origin/main 1d4a1f8f から逐語、`predecessor-question-listing-tools.json`）→新説明の tools-only 境界を、input-derived mock cache と独立 wire assertion で 3 wire 検証（履歴・system・設定・affinity 不変、境界 1 回、次ターンの prefix 再利用、同一 build は境界なし、非 handoff 再起動）。catalog/effective fingerprint は旧≠新を assert（値は固定せず、ビルドごとに変わるため不変条件で記録）。
- M5: 有効な close のある lane は monitor が stall 観測・nudge 要求をしない（`lane_monitor.rs`）。受理側も、close 済み lane への pending nudge は `check_nudge` で stale 扱い（`lane_control/episode.rs`）。回帰テスト `a_closed_lane_is_never_nudged_or_reopened_by_the_monitor`。通常の新規入力による再 open は変更なし。

author: noless-zz
body:
Closes #1386

**Requirement IDs:** CRW-1, CRW-3, SLV-3, ARC-1, ARC-2, MP-2 (and DEV-6 for the acceptance step)

## What changed

The Cargo Rigger's salvage slots and the Reactor Hand's seconds before meltdown now reach the simulation, as start-of-run data handed to `core/` before the first tick, the way the alarm is (Planner's choice on the issue).

- **`core/crew_bonus.gd`** (`CrewBonus`, new): `hold_slots` and `meltdown_seconds`. `Sim.set_crew_bonus` installs it before the first tick:
  - every ship's new `hold_capacity` becomes `HOLD_CAPACITY + hold_slots`;
  - the reactor's new `crew_seconds` is added to the countdown **after** the level's own min/max clamp (`meltdown_ticks`, `meltdown_ticks_for_path`).
- **Hash:** `SimHash` includes the bonus only while it is set. A zero bonus is never installed, written or hashed, so every existing replay and pinned hash stays the same.
- **Replay:** format 21 adds a `crew {"hold_slots":1,"meltdown_seconds":5}` line (`core/replay_crew_line.gd`), chained through `ReplayRulesLine` like the alarm line. It is written only for a non-zero bonus, so other replays keep their version and text. A replay with crew reproduces.
- **Wiring:** `RunWiring.crew_bonus()` (`CrewBenefits.totals` → new `CrewBenefits.bonus`) → `LevelStart.run_rules` → `RunLevelRules.load_files(..., p_crew)` → `install`, which sets it on the sim and the replay. Nothing in `view/` or `xr/` writes it.
- **`CrewBenefits`** no longer says the other stats are "applied by the issues that use them".
- **Acceptance:** new m6 step `crew_bonus` in `suites/m6/effects.json` (lane-b's part), with lane-b's check file `acceptance/checks/crew_bonus_check.gd`.
  - On run 12345 it flies `run_advances.replay` twice through the scene's `LevelStart`, once with a Cargo Rigger and a Reactor Hand in the roster and once with no crew. It restores the run's profile afterwards.
  - It judges that the hold takes 2 parts instead of 1, that the countdown starts 5 s longer (3903 against 3603 ticks), and that the crewed replay flies back to its hash.
  - It also checks that the scene's own crewless run has no bonus.

Possible conflicts with other lanes: `level_start.gd` changes by one line, in `run_rules`. Lane-a's #1424 edits `session_for` in the same file, a separate hunk. No overlap with #1423's files.

## How it was tested

Godot 4.7.2 headless, downloaded from the GitHub release as CI does.

- New `test_crew_bonus.gd` (7 tests):
  - hold size with 0, 1, 2 and 3 riggers, with the cap of 2 held;
  - countdown with 0, 5 and 20 seconds, with the cap held, and the seconds added after the clamp;
  - a zero bonus changes nothing, hash included;
  - the same seed, inputs and bonus give the same hash, and a different bonus gives a different one;
  - the bonus is refused after the first tick, and bad values are refused.
- New `test_replay_crew_line.gd` (6 tests): the line round-trips; a zero crew is not written; bad lines are refused; the pinned `bot_g2_escape` replay keeps its hash and a crewed copy reproduces after save and load; a run whose roster holds a Cargo Rigger and a Reactor Hand flies its level with both, recorded in its replay; a roster without them, or `level_rules` off, adds nothing.
- New `test_crew_bonus_check.gd` (3 tests) for the check's refusals, and to show it leaves the run as it found it.
- `test_replay_lines.gd`: the per-version column table gains version 21.
- `--acceptance=m6` on this branch: 28 of 29 steps pass, `crew_bonus` among them.
  - `crew_bonus` output: "with ["cargo_rigger", "reactor_hand"]: hold 2 parts (1 without), countdown 3903 ticks (3603 without); replay reproduces".
  - **`pickup_marks` fails** ("2 marks for 1 components taken"). It fails the same way on unmodified `main` (`d47e7534`, run in a separate worktree), so this change did not cause it. Its final hash is the pinned one.
- Full unit suite: result added as a comment once it finishes. CI runs on the pushed head.

## Needs a headset check
- With a Cargo Rigger in the crew, fly through two parts: the second must be taken too. Slotting still takes the first part, and the hold message and pickup hint show only the first. Is a fuller hold display needed? That is not in this issue's criteria.
- With a Reactor Hand, the meltdown countdown on the status panel starts 5 s higher than without.

author: ruck-syu
body:
v0.0.3 was published with no app change: editing the workflow file triggered a release, and every release was an automatic patch bump.

- **Guard:** a new `changes` job only lets the release run when `app/` or `crates/` changed since the latest `vX.Y.Z` tag. A manual `workflow_dispatch` run always releases.
- **Versioning:** `app/scripts/next-version.mjs` picks the next version from the PR titles merged since the last tag:
  - patch by default
  - `feat:` → minor
  - a breaking change (`feat!:` or `BREAKING CHANGE:`) → minor before 1.0, major from 1.0 on; a manual `major` run cuts 1.0.0
  - `[skip release]` → no release
  
  Manual runs take a `bump` input. This replaces the `SERIES` version logic that was copied in two places.
- **Release notes:** built from the same PR titles and used in both the GitHub release and the updater's `latest.json`, which used to say only "See the GitHub release notes".
- **Wording:** the "not notarized" note now points to System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway instead of right-click → Open, which no longer works on current macOS.
- **Docs:** `README.md` and `docs/RELEASING.md` describe the new scheme.
- **Example commands:** the command box cycles example commands only until the first command runs, then shows "Type or dictate a command" from then on. A new `ranFirstCommand` setting records the first run and survives restarts. A Settings save can't turn it back off. Add `?examples` in `npm run dev` to preview what a new user sees.

The v0.0.3 release and tag were deleted, so the next release will be numbered 0.0.3 again.

Tests:
- `node --test scripts/next-version.test.mjs` passes (10/10) and now runs in CI.
- `check-versions.mjs` passes and the workflow YAML parses. Run against the real tags, the script reports no release needed for the CI changes alone.
- The full `quality` gate passes locally: both Rust `--lib` suites (617 passed with `tiny-model`), both rule-only equivalence runs, fmt, both clippy runs, lint, finder-handoff and the frontend build. A new test, `the_first_successful_command_stops_the_example_placeholder`, covers the setting.

author: runnane
body:
Fixes ELEG-162. Print History showed 32 of 50 finished prints as ❓ "printing" and its cancelled prints as ✅ completed. The status filter had no option for most rows.

## Cause

`mapTaskStatus` (`src/printer-state.ts`) read 1036's `task_status` as `1 printing, 2 completed, 3 failed, 4 stopped`. The vendor web app, the only renderer of this field we have (`data/raw/index-unminified.html` ~line 104898, local-only), labels the codes `0 Other, 1 Complete, 2 Cancel, 3 Cancel, 4 Printing, 5 Pause`. The firmware sources in `data/CentauriCarbon2` don't encode it (`method.h` only names 1036/1038), and `CC2_PROTOCOL_REFERENCE.md` §1036 shows only `"task_status": 1`.

## Changes

- `src/printer-state.ts`: `mapTaskStatus` (now exported) uses the vendor enum, with the citation in a comment as AGENTS.md asks. 2 and 3 → `stopped`; 4 → `printing`; 5 → `paused`; 0 or anything new → `unknown`.
- `src/ui/print-history.ts`: one `HISTORY_STATUS` table drives both the row icon/title and the status filter: completed ✅, cancelled ⏹ (value `stopped`, so a saved filter still matches), printing 🖨️, paused ⏸, other ❔. The `failed` option is gone, because no code produces it; the vendor app files failures under Cancel.
- `src/ui/list-controls.ts`: a persisted select value the view no longer offers now falls back to "all". Before, it kept filtering behind a select that displayed nothing, so anyone with a saved "failed" History filter would have seen an empty list after this change.

Only the SPA reads `task_status`. The service, `/mcp` and the compat layers don't.

## Decisions made without asking

- 2 and 3 both mean "cancelled", as the vendor app has it. Print Reports, which classifies outcomes itself, remains the place that distinguishes failed from stopped.
- The internal value stays `stopped`, so saved filters keep working; only the label changes to "cancelled".

## Verification

- `pnpm gates` green: **1344 passed** (`main` 1331, +13). CI is github-hosted.
- `history-task-status.test.ts` pins every code to a literal expected label, and checks that every produced status has a display entry. `list-controls-dom.test.ts` gains the stale-filter fallback. Mutations, each restored from a copy and diffed clean:
  - old mapping restored → red at `expect(mapTaskStatus(code)).toBe(expected)`: `expected 'printing' to be 'completed'`;
  - fallback removed (`saved ?? 'all'`) → red at `expect(api.apply(ROWS)).toHaveLength(ROWS.length)`: `expected [] to have a length of 3 but got +0`;
  - `paused` display entry removed → red at `expect(HISTORY_STATUS[status], …).toBeDefined()`.
- **Not verified against real outcomes.** The issue asked for history to match Print Reports for the same jobs. The printer went offline after the print that was running during the walk (`/api/health`: `mqtt: disconnected`), so a read-only 1036 got no reply. That check is ELEG-177.

No printer commands.

body:
Ticket: [LEG-591](https://burnlite.dev/LEG-591), mergeability items and merged lower layers. Part of the spec [LEG-559](https://burnlite.dev/LEG-559).

- **Mergeability:** one item per PR, `m-<pr>`. It is raised on CONFLICTING, or on BEHIND but only when `mergeStateStatus` says BEHIND. It is raised again when the problem, the head or the base changes, and closes by itself at MERGEABLE. UNKNOWN is read again a minute later (AC 31).
- **A merged lower layer:** one item, `ml-<pr>`, "restack the rest". When every layer has merged, the outcome is `merged` (AC 32). That holds even mid-re-entry, while held and while stuck: the check runs before the hold check, which covers the gap LEG-592 left.
- **A layer stacked while stewarding** (scope `stack` only):
  - The watch session's `Stacked` finds it, and it is claimed in one transaction. A claim conflict makes the loop stuck, naming the loop that holds it.
  - It re-enters review once, which counts against `max_reentries`. With `ready`, it is marked ready after that re-entry's confirm (AC 26).
- **Delivery:** these items reach the author tagged `[legato steward]`. No pass waits for answers to them, and their answers are not posted to GitHub.

**Tests:** `internal/handofftest/review_steward_merge_test.go`, and `TestAnUnknownMergeabilityIsReadAgainAfterAMinute`.

**Not done:** there is no httptest test of `ReviewPublisher.Stacked` yet. The per-layer `state` and `mergeable` columns are left for LEG-594's run page.

## Canberra

All 34 playable shop locations now have distinct, locally rendered frontage treatments. Public photographs, heritage registrations, merchant references and OpenStreetMap footprints informed the exteriors. The sources describe the dates, historical tenants and the details that remain estimated. Manuka, Kingston, Civic and the group shops each retain their own street character.

The landmarks pass includes Parliament House, the War Memorial, GIO Stadium, Kippax Fair, both main lake bridges and seven major public buildings, including the Shine Dome, National Library, National Museum and Arboretum Village Centre. Search now finds the seven buildings at their footprints. GIO’s stands leave the pitch open. The shop and landmark renderers retain distance limits and shared geometry. Intel N100 frame rate was not measured.

Streetlighting now uses 661 positions, 442 at surveyed columns. ACT data places 79 barbecues and 112 drinking fountains across 41 suburbs. The Three Receipts campaign chapter has two guided handovers and crew dialogue that responds to the route.

## Startup and arcade

A Chromium CPU profile found repeated shoreline tests in pedestrian path setup. Indexing the shoreline bands cut the isolated, full-map setup from 44.7 to 4.6 CPU seconds with 29,563 paths in the comparison. Bounding the retail precinct index cut measured median construction from 4.21 to 1.25 seconds.

The portal now shows supported human player counts and can copy a direct game link. Repairs include Run 3 level loading, Duck Hunt's missing game chunks, Foldwild's save dialog race, both Subway editions, Frogger's phone board and three archived Flash games. Defense work includes roster name handling, origin checks in the OvO editor, local-only launch paths and removal of obsolete remote dependencies.

## Verification

The fleet review visited every game project. Native controls were confirmed in 139 of 142. The protected chat was checked at its shell, Slope displays its intentional unavailable notice, and Blackout's combat could not be verified on software WebGPU. These were gameplay checks, not complete playthroughs of every title.

The sealed Capital Drive build is `3b359ed1b628`. Chromium entered Free roam and drove at Telopea using normal W/D controls. All eight final build checks, 20 cold/warm/offline checks and 24 worker-update checks passed. A complete road census inspected 27,417 roads and 155,465 segments. It found the same 1,465 occupied static lane samples on 305 roads before and after the additional Kippax Fair shell. The source, style and defensive audit records findings and limits. The shared arcade CI has read-only GitHub permissions.

## Summary
Implement scientifically conservative avalanche readiness and prediction gating, consistent with the Round 1 fallback plan.

## Key changes
- **Status & Requirement Definitions** (`backend/app/avalanche/status.py`, `backend/app/avalanche/requirements.py`):
  - Defined `AvalancheOperationalStatus` (`supported`, `indicative_screening`, `unsupported`) and `AvalancheReadinessAssessment`.
  - Added baseline scientific requirements (`AvalancheRequirements`) and stable, audited reason strings.
- **Readiness Evaluation Engine** (`backend/app/avalanche/readiness.py`):
  - Strict enforcement: missing/stale snowpack (>24h) blocks validated forecasting.
  - Terrain-only inputs (slope, aspect, elevation without telemetry) strictly degrade to unsupported.
  - Missing certified ground-truth event labels prevents supervised validation claims (downgrades complete telemetry to indicative-screening).
- **Feasibility Assessment Report** (`reports/avalanche/feasibility.md`):
  - Full scientific rationale, evidentiary thresholds, and fallback plan documentation.
- **Unit Test Suite** (`backend/tests/avalanche/test_avalanche_readiness.py`):
  - Tests covering terrain-only inputs, missing snowpack, stale snowpack, missing event labels, fully supported state, and custom requirement thresholds.

## How to test
- Run `pytest -v tests/avalanche/`
- Run `ruff check .`

**No fusionar todavía.** Josué ya revisó las preguntas; faltan por leer las correcciones de abajo. Nada de N5 ni de N1 está congelado.

## Correcciones tras la revisión de Josué (27 de noviembre)

Josué aprobó las demás preguntas y respuestas. Estos son los cambios que pidió, con los textos nuevos.

### 1. N1, ficha: la pregunta que ensaya «cociente»

Antes preguntaba por «residuo» y estaba enlazada a `mc-cociente`. Ahora va al revés que el examen (el examen da «cociente» y pide decirlo en popular):

> En la casa dices: «Repartimos 20 tortillas entre 5 y a cada quien le tocaron 4». En la clase de Matemáticas, ese 4 se llama…
> a) el dividendo · b) el divisor · **c) el cociente** · d) el residuo

### 2. N1, ficha: las siete prácticas que faltaban del banco 1-30

La práctica ensaya ahora las 40 del banco de las formas 1 a 30, una por una, como N5.

| ensaya | práctica nueva | respuesta |
|---|---|---|
| `cp-rostro` | Levantar las cejas de sorpresa o apretar los labios de enojo son expresiones del ___. | rostro |
| `cp-planeamiento` | Para preparar la asamblea, en el grado de Kenia nombraron una coordinadora, dos organizadores y un comité de ___. | planeamiento |
| `cp-regionalismo` | Tu prima creció lejos y dice un término que en tu aldea nadie conoce, porque es propio de su región: es un ___. | regionalismo |
| `cp-escuchan` | La enfermera da una charla sobre el lavado de manos: ella expone y los alumnos la ___. | escuchan |
| `pr-postura` | Postura | Karla se queda de pie, derecha, frente al escritorio |
| `pr-literario` | Literario | El verso del cuadro: «El viento peinaba los pinos dormidos» |
| `pr-publicitario` | Publicitario | El afiche: «¡Matricúlate ya! ¡Últimos cupos!» |

Para los tres pareados la escena de Karla creció un poco:

> Karla toca la puerta de la dirección: «Perdone la molestia». En la pared hay un afiche, «¡Matricúlate ya! ¡Últimos cupos!», y un cuadro con un verso: «El viento peinaba los pinos dormidos». Karla entra, se queda de pie, derecha, frente al escritorio, ve a los ojos a la licenciada y dice: «Buenos días, licenciada. Vengo por mi constancia». La licenciada le responde y se la entrega. «Se lo agradezco mucho», dice Karla. Y al salir: «Con permiso, que pase buen día».

Salieron las que ensayaban datos del banco 31-50 (`cp-gesto`, `cp-enfasis`, `cp-oyente`, `cp-familiar`, `pr-intencion`, `pr-interlocutor`, `pr-formalidad`).

### 3. N5, `mc-media-proceso`

Se queda como está.

### 4. N5: definición de complemento circunstancial

En la guía (sección «Párrafo», tarjeta de la oración) y en la ficha (hoja 3):

> **El complemento circunstancial** es la palabra o el grupo de palabras que acompaña al verbo y dice **en qué circunstancias** pasa lo que el verbo cuenta: **cuándo** (de tiempo), **dónde** (de lugar) o **cómo** (de modo). Lo encuentras preguntándole al verbo: «¿cuándo llegaron?» → «Llegaron *ayer*».

La cabecera de `contenido.js` la anota como redacción nuestra: el DCNB lo nombra (p. 151) y no lo define. No dice que se pueda quitar sin que la oración cambie, porque no siempre es así («Vive cerca»).

Para que la hoja 3 de la ficha no quedara al filo, el recuadro «Para Media» pasó a la hoja 2, junto a la revisión.

### Las cinco preguntas abiertas

- «Pisto», «cipote» y «chunche» se quedan.
- «Mirada» y «postura» se quedan.
- Las perífrasis no entran.
- La lista de nacidas queda en `_dev/misiones-nacidas.json`.
- **Tarjeta «Para Media» de N1: quité las glosas de una línea de los seis elementos de la comunicación.** Leí «la tarjeta Para Media sin glosas inventadas» como que no las quieres; ahora la tarjeta nombra los seis elementos y las seis funciones, sin explicarlos con palabras nuestras. Si querías dejarlas, es revertir ese trozo de `n1-conversacion.html`.

## Qué se hizo

### 1. El motor (primer commit, solo motor)

`js/motor-mision.js` arranca cada widget por su cuenta. Una misión nueva ya no tiene que declarar los trece datos heredados de La Célula.

- El widget sin datos no se pinta y esconde su tarjeta. La sección que se queda vacía esconde su pestaña, y la flecha que llevaba a ella salta a la que sigue.
- El paso que revienta lo dice en la consola con su nombre y no se lleva a los demás (antes dejaba sin iniciar el laboratorio y los logros).
- Nombres por lo que hacen, con los de antes como respaldo:

| antes | ahora |
|---|---|
| `routeSets` | `ordenaData` |
| `neuronPartes` | `describeData` |
| `neuroPairs` (`trans`, `func`) | `emparejaData` (`term`, `resp`) |
| `enfermedadData` (`disease`, `characteristic`) | `situacionData` (`term`, `resp`) |
| `idData[].art` | `idData[].busca` |

- `TEXTOS`, `SAVE_KEY`, `ACHIEVEMENTS`, niveles, sopas y tareas tienen valor de reserva. Lo único que el motor no suple es el examen.
- La Célula queda igual: sus 50 formas congeladas salen idénticas (`verifica-formas-oro`).
- `js/motor-misiones.js` no se tocó.

Sondas nuevas:

- `verifica-motor-arranque.js` (va en `npm test`): quita de La Célula cada uno de los trece datos, uno por uno y todos a la vez, y carga los nombres nuevos. Contra el motor de antes da 26 fallos.
- `verifica-motor-arranque-navegador.js`: lo mismo en Chromium, con la página entera.
- `verifica-titulos-ajenos.js`: cada misión de la plantilla lleva su título en sus ocho sitios (pestaña, og:title, `<h1>`, los dos encabezados de examen, los dos títulos en pantalla y la constancia) y no el de otra misión, salvo dentro de un enlace a esa misión. También mira que dos misiones no compartan `SAVE_KEY`.

### 2. N5 · `misiones/3ciclo-n5-escribir/` · Escribir por etapas

Planear, borrador, revisión y versión final; el párrafo y sus tipos; la oración (sujeto, verbo, complemento); la coordinación y el ensayo corto. Laboratorio «la mesa de revisión»: tres borradores (un experimento de Ciencias, una división de decimales, un párrafo sobre Copán) con tres fallas cada uno.

### 3. N1 · `misiones/3ciclo-n1-conversacion/` · Conversar en lengua estándar

Lo verbal y lo no verbal; entonación, énfasis y pausas; fórmulas sociales; charlas, trabajo de equipo, diálogos y asambleas; niveles de la lengua; lenguaje libre de discriminación. Laboratorio «la misma noticia, cuatro bocas».

Cada misión trae: página, `js/contenido.js` (solo datos), `js/<slug>-propio.js` (laboratorio) y `js/ficha.js` (bloque de la ficha). Cada contenido lleva la etiqueta de su grado («7.º», «8.º», «9.º», «Para Media»).

## Dónde están las preguntas

| qué | N5 · `misiones/3ciclo-n5-escribir/js/` | N1 · `misiones/3ciclo-n1-conversacion/js/` |
|---|---|---|
| Examen, formas 1 a 30 (40 preguntas) | `contenido.js`, líneas 360 a 407 | `contenido.js`, líneas 344 a 391 |
| Examen, formas 31 a 50 (40 preguntas) | `contenido.js`, líneas 422 a 469 | `contenido.js`, líneas 411 a 458 |

| Práctica de la ficha (40 preguntas) | `ficha.js`, desde la línea 164 | `ficha.js`, desde la línea 164 |
| De dónde sale cada dato y qué se suavizó | cabecera de `contenido.js` | cabecera de `contenido.js` |

Cada pregunta del examen lleva `grado` y `curriculo` (página de la programación o del DCNB). Las 40 del banco nuevo llevan además `fuente` (dónde lo enseña la misión).

## Decisiones que tomé en la tanda

1. **La lista de nacidas va fuera de `_dev/formas-oro/`** (`_dev/misiones-nacidas.json`, que `lib-formas.js` lee junto con la de antes). Josué la deja así.

author: aixxww
body:
Part of #111, slice **S2** (review item A: versioned packet plus a fail-closed check). Base: `t2/v7-selection` @ `19c69b47` (the #121 merge).

## Changes
1. **Version header in both modes.**
   - The legacy candidate section now prints `payload_version=legacy | doctrine_version=none` on the line before `Tier Summary:` (`kernel/engine_prompt.go`).
   - The hybrid_v2 line keeps its format, `payload_version=hybrid_v2 | doctrine_version=hunter-v7-doctrine-hybrid-v2 | prompt_time_utc=…`. Both modes now render the pair through one helper, `hunterV7PromptHeader`.
   - **Difference from the review draft:** the legacy line has no `prompt_time_utc`. The legacy path has no fixed prompt time (`ctx.PromptTime` is unset there, so it would fall back to `time.Now()` and make the goldens non-deterministic), and the legacy prompt already prints the round time.
   - The frozen `V7PromptPayload` JSON is unchanged, so per-candidate bytes are identical.
2. **Rejected at save.** `store.ValidateTradingConfig` rejects any `coin_source.hunter_config.v7_prompt.payload_version` other than `""`, `legacy` or `hybrid_v2` (new `store.ValidV7PayloadVersion`). The three strategy save paths in `api/strategy.go` already call it. `EffectiveV7Prompt` still reads an unknown value as legacy, for display and offline tools.
3. **Fail-closed contract before the AI call.** New `kernel/hunter_v7_prompt_contract.go`. `GetFullDecisionWithStrategy` calls `hunterV7PromptContractError(systemPrompt, userPrompt)` after building the prompts. hunter_v7 only; other source types are not checked. A round is stopped when any of these holds:
   - the stored `payload_version` is unknown (for example a row saved before this change);
   - the payload/doctrine pair is not in `hunterV7KnownPromptPairs`;
   - the system prompt lacks the doctrine of the selected version, or carries the other one (matched by doctrine heading; a test pins the headings to the doctrine texts);
   - the user prompt has a tier section (`Tier Summary:`) but not the selected header, or carries another version's header;
   - a hybrid_v2 strategy's own `prompt_sections` / `custom_prompt` cite legacy-only doctrine content (`llm_action`, `剧本`, `playbook`). That is the strategy-07 pairing gap from the review.

   A stopped round returns one decision, `{"symbol":"ALL","action":"wait","blocked_reason_code":"backend_guard_risk","reasoning":"prompt_contract_mismatch: …"}`, with no error. The AI is not called, so the round is neither an AI call nor an AI failure (no safe-mode feed). The error is logged as `[prompt_contract_mismatch]`, and both prompts are kept on the FullDecision for audit.
3a. **No phantom AI charge (review fix, head `b073cba`).** The contract-stopped decision carries a typed marker, `kernel.FullDecision.AINotCalled = true`. In `trader/auto_trader_loop.go` the charge call is now `at.recordAICharge(aiDecision)`, which records nothing when the decision is nil or `AINotCalled`. Before, the loop recorded one flat-priced `ai_charges` row for every non-nil decision, so each contract-stopped round booked a phantom AI call. A round that called the AI still books exactly one charge, whatever its outcome.
   - **Same root cause, also fixed (flagging it because it was not in the review finding):** the success path reset `consecutiveAIFailures` and left safe mode ("AI is working again") after any round without an error. A contract-stopped round would have counted as an AI recovery and switched off safe mode. That reset now lives in `at.noteAISuccess(aiDecision)` and is skipped for `AINotCalled` rounds. Tell me if you want it split into its own PR.
4. **Persisted.** `payload_version` is stored next to `doctrine_version` on Hunter v7 signal records. The new column is `hunter_v7_signal.payload_version`; GORM AutoMigrate adds it, so no manual migration is needed. It is filled from the strategy's effective prompt config through `HunterV7RecordTagOptions.PayloadVersion` and `V7SignalTags.PayloadVersion`, with default `legacy`.
5. **Version bump policy** is documented at the top of `hunter_v7_prompt_contract.go`. A breaking change to field names, types or meaning in `V7PromptPayload` or `hunterV7V2*` requires a new payload-version constant and its pair (`legacy` → `legacy_2`, `hybrid_v2` → `hybrid_v3`). Adding an omitempty field does not bump.

## Goldens
| Golden | Change |
|---|---|
| `kernel/testdata/hunter_v7_prompt_legacy_en.golden`, `…_legacy_zh.golden` | +1 line each (the header) |
| `kernel/testdata/golden-prompt-20260726.txt` | +1 line (the header). Re-recording would also inline the `execution_contract` that the test injects at compare time, so I restored the file and inserted only the header line. |
| hybrid_v2 goldens, replay golden | unchanged |

## Tests
- `kernel/hunter_v7_prompt_contract_s2_test.go`:
  - `TestS2HeaderAndContractPass`: the header is present in legacy and hybrid, EN and ZH, and correctly paired rounds pass. Non-hunter_v7 strategies are not checked.
  - `TestS2ContractFailsClosed` covers each failure mode:
    - an unknown stored version;
    - legacy payload with the hybrid doctrine;
    - hybrid payload with the legacy doctrine;
    - both doctrines present;
    - a legacy strategy with a hybrid user prompt;
    - a stray other-version header.

    A user prompt with no tier section needs no header.
  - `TestS2TemplatePairing`: strategy-07 passes as stored (legacy). Strategy-07 with `hybrid_v2` reports `llm_action` / `剧本` and fails the contract. Every template in `docs/strategy-prompt-templates/` passes as stored.
  - `TestS2DoctrineHeadingsMatchTheDoctrines`: every doctrine (two modes × two languages) starts with the heading the contract matches, and the known pairs match the store.
  - `TestS2GetFullDecisionFailsClosedWithoutCallingAI`: end to end through `GetFullDecisionWithStrategy` with a stub AI client that fails the test if called. A stored `hybrid_v3` gives one wait / `backend_guard_risk` / `prompt_contract_mismatch: …`, a nil error, and the prompts kept.
  - `TestS2PayloadVersionTag`: records carry `legacy`, or `hybrid_v2` under hybrid.
- `trader/ai_charge_contract_s2_test.go` (review fix):
  - `TestS2ContractStoppedRoundBooksNoAICharge`: against a real store, a contract-stopped decision and a nil decision book 0 `ai_charges` rows; an AI round books exactly 1, with the model's price.
  - `TestS2ContractStoppedRoundIsNotAIRecovery`: after a contract-stopped round, the failure counter (3) and safe mode are unchanged; an AI round resets them.
  - The kernel side, that the stopped decision is marked `AINotCalled`, is asserted in `TestS2GetFullDecisionFailsClosedWithoutCallingAI`.
- `store/hunter_v7_prompt_version_s2_test.go`:
  - `TestS2ValidateTradingConfigRejectsUnknownPayloadVersion`: `""`, `legacy` and `hybrid_v2` are accepted; `hybrid_v3`, `Hybrid_V2` and `"legacy "` are rejected.
  - `TestS2PayloadVersionColumn`: AutoMigrate creates the column and a record round-trips.
- `TestU11DefaultIsLegacy` is kept: `EffectiveV7Prompt` still reads unknown values as legacy. Its comment now points to the save rejection and the runtime fail-closed path.

## Verification (head `b073cba`)
- `go build ./...`: exit 0.
- `go test ./... -count=1`: 34 packages `ok`, zero FAIL. I ran the S2 kernel tests three times because one check iterates a map; they are deterministic.
- `go vet ./kernel ./store`: clean. `gofmt -l` on the changed files: clean.
- Toolchain: go 1.25.3.

Scope: S2 only. The strategy RR, positions and confidence params, A2 thresholds, Task 1 and live trading are untouched.

## Summary
- **New Master course: Medical robotics** (`learn-medical.html`, 8 lessons, EN + FR), written from the M2 course of P. Vieyres (PRISME, Université d'Orléans). It covers:
  - history of surgery, imaging and medical robots
  - the doctor in the loop: teleoperation, motion scaling, tremor filtering
  - degrees of freedom, the trocar, the fulcrum effect and the remote centre of motion (RCM)
  - co-manipulation: parallel, serial and orthotic; virtual fixtures
  - safety, sterility, the operating room, CE marking (Regulation (EU) 2017/745)
  - hospital robots: da Vinci, AESOP, Robodoc, CyberKnife, proton therapy, exoskeletons
  - robotic tele-ultrasound and the PRISME prototypes
  - a method for the mini-project

author: ioanbeilic
body:
## Qué pasa

En Automatizaciones, al crear una automatización y elegir «Pasa algo», la lista «Elige qué pasa» enseñaba algunos avisos con su nombre interno a medio traducir en vez de una frase: «Bandeja de WhatsApp: channel connected», «Bandeja de WhatsApp: template alta», «Impresión: device cambio», «Citas: appointment restored». En inglés, «WhatsApp inbox: template sample uploaded» o «Printing: job pruned».

Contados hoy en todas las apps instaladas eran **27**, no 21: los 21 de la issue (vistos en una peluquería) y seis más de apps que una peluquería no tenía encendidas: el título de una cuenta de Ventas, el bono que se vincula a su venta en Servicios y los cuatro de Propinas.

## Por qué pasaba

La pantalla nombra cada aviso con su frase de `apps/flow/frontend/locale/{en,es}.json` (`flow.events.<app>__<entidad>__<hecho>`). Cuando la frase no existe, `eventLabel` (`apps/flow/frontend/lib/phrasing.ts`) compone «<App>: <entidad> <hecho>» con las palabras internas. Nada avisaba de que un aviso nuevo llegaba sin frase: las acciones ya tenían esa prueba (`test_action_words.py`), los avisos no.

## Qué cambia

1. **22 avisos tienen ya su frase, en inglés y en español**, escrita como las demás («se conecta el número de WhatsApp», «se crea una plantilla de WhatsApp», «se prepara un dispositivo para imprimir», «se publica la página web», «se deja una propina», «cambia el título de una cuenta»…), con las palabras que usa cada app en su pantalla (Propinas «corrige» una propina; la web se «desconecta»; la conversación «necesita atención»).
2. **Cinco avisos dejan de ofrecerse**, porque no arrancan nada:
   - `printing.job.pruned`: la limpieza de cada hora que olvida los trabajos de impresión de hace más de 30 días. Es mantenimiento del sistema, no algo que pase en el negocio. Así lo hace el mercado: Zapier pide que los disparadores de una app sigan lo que hace su usuario, no lo que expone su API ([guía de Zapier](https://docs.zapier.com/platform/build/trigger)), y Shopify Flow, Make o Square ofrecen una lista escogida de cosas que pasan en la tienda (pedidos, clientes, pagos), nunca la limpieza de su historial ([referencia de Shopify Flow](https://help.shopify.com/en/manual/shopify-flow/reference)).
   - `appointment.appointment.restored`, `appointment.recurring.restored`, `customer.customer.restored` e `inventory.product.restored`: solo los anota la recuperación de un negocio desde una copia aparte, que hace el equipo de ERPlora, y Automatizaciones no arranca nunca con lo que trae una recuperación (ya era así y lo prueba `test_recovery.py`). Ofrecerlos era ofrecer un arranque que no se dispara jamás. («se recupera un servicio», que es desarchivarlo a mano, sí se sigue ofreciendo.)

   No había forma de no ofrecer un aviso: la lista sale de `events.ALL` de cada app, y esa misma lista es la que comprueban las pantallas vivas (Impresión refresca sus colas con la limpieza), así que no se podían quitar de ahí. Cada app lo dice en su `events.py` con `SYSTEM_ONLY`, igual que ya dice qué datos de sus avisos son importes (`events.AMOUNTS`), y el catálogo de Automatizaciones lo lee (`queries.catalog._events_of`). Siguen en `events.ALL`: nada cambia para las pantallas ni para las reacciones de otras apps. Una automatización ya guardada con uno de ellos (nunca se disparaba) sale en el editor como aviso que no existe, para que se elija otro.
3. **Lo que impide que vuelva**: `apps/flow/tests/test_event_words.py` recorre todos los avisos que declara cada app instalada, comprueba que la lista los ofrece todos salvo los de `SYSTEM_ONLY`, que cada uno tiene su frase en inglés y en español, y que los de `SYSTEM_ONLY` ni salen en el catálogo ni se pueden guardar como arranque. Un aviso nuevo sin frase rompe la prueba.
4. **En pantalla**: `tests/e2e/fix-flow-trigger-list-reads-a-phrase.spec.ts` abre «Elige qué pasa» en inglés y en español en los tres tamaños y lee la lista entera: ninguna opción compuesta con palabras internas, las frases nuevas en su sitio y ninguno de los cinco avisos que ya no se ofrecen.
5. **WORKBOOK de Automatizaciones** (y su traducción): FLOW-F10 dice que no salen los avisos que solo anota la plataforma, y la nota para quien lo mantiene explica `events.SYSTEM_ONLY` y la prueba de las frases.

Componentes revisados: Combo de @erplora/ui (la lista «Elige qué pasa», catálogo COMPONENTS.md) · TriggerCard.vue · phrasing.ts (eventLabel) · reutilizo Combo y eventLabel tal cual / creo nada porque el cambio son textos y qué avisos ofrece el catálogo, sin tocar interfaz

## Cómo se comprueba

Antes del cambio, sobre `main` (la prueba nueva en rojo por lo que falta):

```
$ TEST_DB_NAME=test_hub_2544 uv run pytest -q -n 2 apps/flow/tests/test_event_words.py
E       AssertionError: assert ['appointment...retired', ...] == []
E         Left contains 27 more items, first extra item: 'appointment.appointment.restored'
E         Extra items in the left set:
E         'appointment.recurring.restored'
E         'inventory.product.restored'
E         'printing.job.pruned'
E         'customer.customer.restored'
E         'appointment.appointment.restored'
3 failed in 50.85s
```

Después:

```
$ TEST_DB_NAME=test_hub_2544 uv run pytest -q -n 2 apps/flow/tests
1135 passed in 230.64s (0:03:50)

# las pruebas de otras apps que leen el catálogo o los events.py tocados (los test_events.py y test_apps.py de
# cart_checkout, cash_register, combo, customer, invoice, payment, pricing, sale, service, task, printing, appointment
# e inventory, whatsapp_inbox/tests/test_api.py, base/tests/test_queries_home_bell.py, base/tests/test_queries_system.py
# y tests/test_guardrails_assistant.py)
448 passed in 95.45s (0:01:35)

$ TEST_DB_NAME=test_hub_2544 uv run pytest -q -n 2 base/tests/test_locale_modules.py base/tests/test_locale_platform.py apps/flow/tests/test_i18n.py
31 passed in 56.24s

$ pnpm exec vitest run apps/flow --maxWorkers=2
 Test Files  43 passed (43)
      Tests  423 passed (423)

$ uv run python manage.py check
System check identified no issues (0 silenced).

$ CI=1 pnpm e2e tests/e2e/fix-flow-trigger-list-reads-a-phrase.spec.ts      # pila propia
  6 passed (1.5m)
```

La e2e caza el fallo: con el `es.json` de `main` cae en español porque la pantalla enseña la frase inglesa como respaldo:

```
    Error: whatsapp_inbox.channel.connected
    Expected: "se conecta el número de WhatsApp"
    Received: "the WhatsApp number is connected"
  1 failed
```

Mutantes ejecutados contra `test_event_words.py` (cada uno comprobado con `grep -cF` = 1 antes de aplicarlo):

| Mutante | Prueba que cae |
|---|---|
| Borrar `"tip__tip__voided": "se anula una propina",` de `es.json` | `test_every_event_the_list_offers_has_its_words_in_both_languages` (`['tip.tip.voided'] == []`) |
| Dejar en blanco la frase inglesa de `whatsapp_inbox__channel__connected` | la misma (`['whatsapp_inbox.channel.connected'] == []`) |
| Quitar `and name not in system_only` de `queries/catalog.py` | las tres |

Comprobaciones antes de subir (`VITEST_MAX_THREADS=2 VITEST_MAX_FORKS=2 bash scripts/checks.sh fast`): salida 0. Guardarraíles de tamaño, ruff, complejidad e imports: `153 passed in 8.70s`; ESLint y `pnpm typecheck` sin avisos; Vitest relacionado `411 passed`; pruebas de los WORKBOOK y de los `events.py` tocados `330 passed`.

- WORKBOOK traducido (`workbook-guard.sh`): `OK`
- Duplicados y estilos (`dup-guard.sh`): `OK`

Tamaño (líneas antes → después; ninguno está en la lista de excepciones; los `.json` de textos son datos y no cuentan):

| Fichero | Antes | Después |
|---|---|---|
| `apps/flow/queries/catalog.py` | 297 | 300 |
| `apps/printing/events.py` | 74 | 76 |
| `apps/appointment/events.py` | 147 | 150 |
| `apps/customer/events.py` | 99 | 102 |
| `apps/inventory/events.py` | 78 | 81 |
| `apps/flow/tests/test_event_words.py` | nuevo | 65 |
| `tests/e2e/fix-flow-trigger-list-reads-a-phrase.spec.ts` | nuevo | 97 |

## Qué queda fuera

- La línea gris bajo cada opción con la app y el nombre interno («Band

author: oscarlehuu
body:
Part of #314. Web only: the iPhone card is a second pull request after this one (Capy's #308 is changing `ios/src/chat/`, so `ios/` is untouched here).

## What it does

`connection.sign_in` was returned as `null` in `web/src/chat/chat-item.tsx`. It now draws the card approved on Paper artboard 25 (with the artboard 13 revision), in every state the server holds:

- **Waiting** (first face): letter badge, "Sign in to {service}", the bot's label as a small tag, "{bot} wants to use it", a countdown to `expiresAt`, the service address and, when it differs from the service host, "You sign in at {providerDomain}"; the bot's reason; **Sign in** and **Cancel**.
- **After Sign in** on this device: "Waiting for {providerDomain}", the finishes-by-itself line, and the paste field with **Finish** (disabled until the text looks like a web address); **Open sign-in again** and **Cancel**.
- **Settled one-liners**: connected, cancelled (with the server's reason, e.g. "This connection was removed."), ran out and failed, the last two with **Start again**.

Buttons call `connections.signIn.open`, `.finish`, `.cancel`, `.restart`. The card's state is always the server's: live `connection.sign_in` events replace the card in place, and after a reload it comes from history (the server reconciles expiry before `chat.open`/`chat.history`).

## Security (docs/connections.md, "Sign-in cards in conversation (#216)")

- **Opening from the click (review fix).** A `window.open` after an await is blocked by Safari, and by any browser once the click's activation is stale; with `noopener` the card could not even tell. Now Sign in (and Open sign-in again) opens a blank tab synchronously inside the click, sets `tab.opener = null`, then fetches the link and sends that tab to it through a `<meta name="referrer" content="no-referrer">` plus `<meta http-equiv="refresh">` written into the tab's own document (`web/src/connections/sign-in-tab.ts`). The navigation is started by the tab's own document, not LilBot's page, so LilBot's referrer is never sent. Only a `http(s)` link is sent on; if fetching it fails, the blank tab is closed.
- **A blocked tab leaves the card truthful:** the card stays on its first face (no "Waiting for …", no paste field) with "Your browser blocked the sign-in page. Allow pop-ups for LilBot, then press Sign in again."
- I chose this over "fetch, then show a real link" because it keeps one press for Oscar and the link never sits in the page (the other option has to hold it in state until he presses).
- The sign-in link is not kept in state, stores, history or logs.
- The pasted address lives only in the component's input state; it is sent once to `connections.signIn.finish` and cleared. No new store, log or history path.
- Bot-provided `label` and `reason` are rendered as React text (no HTML), wrapped, never as links.
- Nothing new reaches a bot.

## Shared for the iPhone card

`shared/client/connections/sign-in-card.ts` (pure): the phase (`open` / `opened` / `ended`), countdown, ended-line wording and tone, when Start again is offered, when "You sign in at" shows, and when Finish is enabled. The iPhone card can import it the way `shared/client/memory/checkpoint-refusal-copy.ts` is shared.

## Decided myself

- "After Sign in" is device-local (an in-memory map of card id → the expiry it was pressed for, never the link), keyed on the card's `expiresAt`, so a restart or a second sign-in from the bot (both give a fresh expiry) brings the card back to its first face; a reload or another device also shows the first face, and its Sign in still works.
- A waiting card whose time runs out flips to the ran-out line on the client at once (the server's own update follows within a second).
- The card loads lazily with the first one, like other chat cards, so the first-load bundle does not grow.
- Disabled Finish keeps the app's own disabled button style (readable, not the drawing's pale grey).

## Guide wording (changed here)

`server/system/guide/connections.md` now says: "Tell Oscar briefly that the card is in this conversation in the web app (not yet in the iPhone app) and wait". **The words "in the web app (not yet in the iPhone app)" come out again when the iPhone card ships.**

## Tests

- `tests/connections/sign-in-card-view.test.ts`: pure phase, countdown, wording, Finish enablement (refuses `javascript:` and non-addresses).
- `tests/web/sign-in-tab.test.ts`: the tab opens with no address (so inside the click), its opener is cut, a blocked pop-up gives null, the link goes only into that tab with a no-referrer policy, and the blank tab closes when the link cannot be fetched.
- `tests/connections/sign-in-card-flow.test.ts`: the real backend's card events played into the client's chat state: pasted-address finish (and the address is not in any card event); **card runs out while the paste field is open**, then Start again; **a second sign-in replaces the first in place**; **the connection is removed while waiting**; failed then Start again then cancel.
- `bun run verify` passes locally; CI green.

## Real browser

Real Chrome against an isolated dev server (`bun run dev:setup`, run under `~/lilbot-dev/live-check.lock`), a temporary bot on the dev gateway (deleted after), and the repo's local OAuth test service (`tests/connections/service-fixture.ts`). Each card was placed by the bot calling `lilbot_connection` for real; every state below was reached for real, not mocked. Wide = 1440 × 900, phone = 390 × 844, light and dark.

**Waiting** (first face)
![waiting](https://github.com/LieuGroup/lilbot/blob/6908b18adeebd67a1ae58c8bdc9e1aadd18377a4/314-1-waiting.png?raw=true)

**After Sign in**: the service page opened in a new tab (`window.opener` null and empty `document.referrer` in that tab, checked), then the paste field. Finish stays disabled for "not an address" (dark, 2nd frame)
![after sign in](https://github.com/LieuGroup/lilbot/blob/6908b18adeebd67a1ae58c8bdc9e1aadd18377a4/314-2-after-sign-in.png?raw=true)

**Pasted-address finish → connected**: the address the service sent the new tab back to, pasted into the card, Finish, then the connected line (live update, no reload)
![pasted and connected](https://github.com/LieuGroup/lilbot/blob/6908b18adeebd67a1ae58c8bdc9e1aadd18377a4/314-3-pasted-connected.png?raw=true)

**Ran out** (expiry set to 150 s for the check with `LILBOT_CONNECTION_TEST_SIGN_IN_SECONDS`; the line appeared 150 s after the card was placed), **after a reload**, and **Start again** bringing the card back to its first face with a fresh countdown
![settled, reload, start again](https://github.com/LieuGroup/lilbot/blob/6908b18adeebd67a1ae58c8bdc9e1aadd18377a4/314-4-settled-reload.png?raw=true)

**All four lines after a reload**, light | dark: connected, cancelled (Cancel on the card), failed (a refused sign-in pasted into the card: `error=access_denied`), ran out. Measured contrast of the failed line's red text: 4.98:1 light, 5.34:1 dark.
![lines](https://github.com/LieuGroup/lilbot/blob/6908b18adeebd67a1ae58c8bdc9e1aadd18377a4/314-5-lines.png?raw=true)

**Pop-up blocked** (`window.open` made to return null in the page, as a blocker does): the card stays on its first face with the note.
![pop-up blocked](https://github.com/LieuGroup/lilbot/blob/667f19830f16bab96b4d690ba284c9ba2404fcfd/314-6-popup-blocked.png?raw=true)

**Opener and referrer, re-checked after the change:** in the run above every opened tab had `window.opener === null` and an empty `document.referrer`. Separately, a two-origin probe in Chrome (a page on one origin clicking Sign in through `sign-in-tab.ts`, the sign-in page on another) recorded at the sign-in page: no `Referer` header, `window.opener === null`, `document.referrer` empty; the opened tab came from the click.

**Browsers:** only Chrome (156, headless). Safari and Firefox are not installed on this machine, so the Safari pop-up behaviour that motivated the change is reasoned from how Safari treats `window.open` after an await, not obse

body:
## 무엇이 참이 되는가

감사에서 나온 시험 다섯 자리가 **옛(틀린) 동작에서 실제로 붉어진다.** 제품 코드(`settle.ts` · `notice.ts` · 마이그레이션 · CI 워크플로)는 건드리지 않았다.

```diff
 src/lib/consent/notice.test.ts        부재 단언 15개 걷음, 1자리는 반증 가능한 단언으로 옮김
 app/me/credits/refusal.test.ts        sources.some(...) → start_reading_run_for 의 마지막 정의
 app/api/store/google-play/settle.test.ts  + 이용 중 아님의 환불 호출 · 환불 실패 · orderId null
 app/ops/denial.boundary.test.ts       + 양성 대조 · 훑는 파일 수 하한 · 집(denial.ts)이 두 글자를 드는지
+playwright.flaky-reporter.ts          CI 에서 흔들림 수를 job 요약 · 경고 알림으로 세운다
 playwright.config.ts                  reporter: 'github' → [['github'], ['./playwright.flaky-reporter.ts']]
 docs/agents/test-map/kinds.md         + 「e2e 의 다시 돌리기」
```

### 1. `notice.test.ts` — 줄마다의 판정 (ADR 0079 의 세 갈래)

모든 줄의 글자가 `src/` · `app/` · `mobile/src` 의 제품 코드에 없다는 것을 `grep -F` 로 확인했다(시험 파일 · 주석만 걸림). 판본이 돌아가는 것은 `noticeAckHolds` 시험과 각 판의 긍정 단언이 막는다.

| 줄 | 단언 | 판정 | 까닭 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 262 | `not '뒤이어'` | 걷음 | 바로 위 긍정이 「3일 이내에 같은 방법으로 … 이 기간 안에 지웁니다」를 글자 그대로 잼 |
| 288 | `not '사주풀이·궁합풀이를 받지 않고 궁합 요청도 수락되지 않으면'` | 걷음 | v8 이전 문장. 같은 시험의 긍정 셋이 지금 문장을 잼 |
| 301-302 | `not '두 분의 닉네임'` · `not '붙인 이름과'` | **옮김** | 잴 뜻이 있다(이름 · 닉네임은 모델로 안 간다, ADR 0180). 새 시험 「모델로 가는 것을 말하는 줄은 닉네임 · 이름을 보내는 것으로 적지 않는다」 — `모델에는…` 줄과 OpenAI 이전 항목 줄의 문장 가운데 닉네임 · 이름이 든 것은 모두 「보내지 않」을 든다. 하한 둘(줄 ≥2 · 문장 ≥2)로 빈 통과를 막는다 |
| 306 | `not '여덟 글자와 그 위에서 나온 사실만 보냅니다'` | 걷음 | 긍정 「계산된 명식과 태어난 해·나이·성별 등 분석 정보」가 그 반대 사실을 잼 |
| 336 | `not '세 곳 모두 국외에 서버를 둡니다'` | 걷음 | 같은 시험의 서울 리전 긍정 셋 · `outward not '구글 계정 이메일'`(살아 있는 글자라 반증 가능)이 잼 |
| 362 | `not '하나로 정해'` | 걷음 | 옛 역산 문장의 조각. 같은 시험의 `not '60년'` 은 앞으로 쓸 법한 말이라 둠 |
| 393 | `not '운영자가 확인한 뒤'` | 걷음 | 긍정 「탈퇴를 신청하시면 3일 이내에 파기합니다」 · 「자동으로 지웁니다」가 잼 |
| 404-405 | `not '궁합 요청이 수락되어'` · `not '드러날 수 있습니다'` | 걷음 | `MATCH_DETAIL_DISCLOSURE` 줄 전부를 긍정으로 잼 |
| 459-461 | 카카오 이메일 부재 셋(`it` 하나) | 걷음(시험째) | 앞 시험이 「카카오계정 이메일(필수)을 받습니다」를 긍정으로 잼 |
| 599 | `not 'Google LLC(미국'` | 걷음 | 긍정이 하나뿐인 Google LLC 줄의 나라를 글자 그대로 잼 |

같은 꼴인데 감사 목록에 없어 남긴 것: `:403` `not '여덟 글자가 공개돼요'` — 그 글자는 제품 코드에 없지만 인연(G-135) 쪽 시험(`scripts/match-talk-stays-off.test.ts`)이 같은 글자를 재는 자리라 이번 범위 밖으로 두었다.

### 5. e2e 흔들림

```text
onEnd (CI 일 때만, github 리포터 곁에서)
  flaky = 모든 시험 중 outcome() === 'flaky'
  GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY 에 "### e2e 흔들림 N건 (시험 M건, 다시 돌리기 2번까지)" + 시험마다 한 줄   ← 0 이어도 적는다
  N > 0 이면 ::warning title=e2e 흔들림:: 한 줄
```

`retries: 2` 와 무엇이 붉은가는 그대로다. 워크플로(`verify.yml`)는 안 바꿨다 — `GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY` 는 러너가 모든 단계에 준다.
리포터는 기본 내보내기가 필요해 `e2e/` 가 아니라 설정 곁에 두었다(`e2e/**` 는 `import/no-default-export`). class 는 금지라 객체를 돌려주는 함수다(`new` 가 그 객체를 낸다).

## 잰 값

- **e2e 흔들림이 정말 숨어 있었나** — verify 의 최근 완료 실행 20개의 `anon` · `authed` job 알림(`gh api …/check-runs/<id>/annotations`)을 훑었다. **5개 실행 · 6개 job 에 흔들림 10건**이 있었고 job 은 모두 초록이었다. 가장 잦은 것은 `e2e/match.spec.ts:735`「보관함 복원 회귀」(5번)였다.
- 감사 문장과 다른 점: 「flaky 수가 어디에도 안 선다」는 정확히는 아니다. `github` 리포터가 job 마다 `notice` 알림 「Playwright Run Summary」에 `N flaky` 를 적고, 흔들린 시험마다 `error` 알림도 낸다(흔들림이라는 표시는 없다). 하지만 job 요약에는 아무것도 없었고, 차선 열 개의 알림을 하나씩 열어야 보였다.
- `refusal.test.ts` — 앞머리 「풀이권을 다 쓰셨습니다」를 던지는 마이그레이션이 13개 파일이었다. 마지막 정의는 `20270112090000_a_new_member_gets_one_free_credit.sql` 의 `start_reading_run_for` 다. 몸을 끝내는 표시가 파일마다 `$$` · `$function$` 로 달라, `as $tag$` 와 짝이 맞는 태그까지 자른다. 그 파일의 `grant … on function` 줄은 정의가 아니라 뺀다.

## 돌린 것

- `npx vitest run src/lib/consent app/me/credits app/api/store app/ops/denial.boundary.test.ts app/ops/second-factor.boundary.test.ts app/notice-version.boundary.test.ts` — **25 파일 · 274 통과**
- `npx vitest run scripts/` (문서를 고쳐서) — **80 파일 · 1370 통과 · 3 건너뜀**(잠긴 백필)
- `npm run typecheck` — 통과
- `npx eslint --max-warnings 0` 바꾼 파일 여섯 — 통과
- `CI=1 npx playwright test --list --project=desktop-chromium` — 실제 설정이 새 리포터와 함께 뜬다(51건 목록)
- 심은 시험(첫 시도에 붉고 다시 돌면 통과)에 리포터를 붙여 `GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY` 를 임시 파일로 돌렸다:
  - 흔들림 있음 → 종료 0. 요약 `### e2e 흔들림 1건 (시험 2건, 다시 돌리기 2번까지)` + 시험 한 줄, `::warning title=e2e 흔들림::1건 — 다시 돌아 통과했다…`
  - 흔들림 없음 → 종료 0. 요약 `### e2e 흔들림 0건 (시험 2건, 다시 돌리기 2번까지)`, 경고 없음
- **안 돌린 것**: 전체 `npm test`(heavy 잠금 — 바꾼 파일의 시험과 `scripts/` 만 돌렸다). `npm run test:e2e:notice`(관문 · 고지 본문은 안 바꾸고 시험 파일만 바꿨다). e2e 전체 — 이 PR 은 계획기가 「모르는 파일」로 전부를 돌리므로, 새 리포터가 실제 job 요약에 서는지는 이 PR 의 CI 가 처음 보인다.

## 잠금이면 일부러 어긴 것

각 시험이 옛 동작에서 붉어지는지는 원본을 잠깐 바꿔(돌린 뒤 되돌림) **새 시험과 옛 시험(`git show HEAD:` 사본)을 함께** 돌려 보았다. 옛 시험은 모든 경우에 초록이었다.

| 항목 | 심은 옛(틀린) 동작 | 새 시험 | 옛 시험 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 notice | OpenAI 이전 항목에 「고르신 사이와 두 사람의 닉네임」 | 붉음(1) | 초록 |
| 2 refusal | 마지막 정의의 거절을 「풀이권이 다 떨어졌어요.」로(옛 마이그레이션은 그대로) | 붉음(1) | 초록 |
| 3 settle M1 | `inactive` 는 환불을 안 부름 | 붉음(2) | 초록 |
| 3 settle M2 | 환불이 실패하면 소비로 새고 기록 없음 | 붉음(1) | 초록 |
| 3 settle M3 | 환불 실패를 기록하지 않음 | 붉음(1) | 초록 |
| 3 settle M4 | `orderId === null` 이어도 환불을 부름(`?? ''`) | 붉음(1) | 초록 |
| 4 denial D1 | 훑는 필터가 아무 파일도 못 잡음(`/\.tsz$/`) | 붉음(하한) | 초록 |
| 4 denial D2 | 정규식 오타 `42051` | 붉음(양성 대조 · 집) | 초록 |
| 4 denial D3 | 주석 걷기가 코드까지 지움 | 붉음(양성 대조 · 집) | 해당 없음(옛 시험은 같은 걷기로 늘 빈 목록 → 초록) |
| 5 리포터 | 심은 흔들림 시험 | 요약 `1건` + 경고 | (전에는 job 요약 없음) |

## 문서

결정 여부: 없음 — 「검증 · 배포의 문턱」을 바꾸지 않았다. CI 워크플로 · 계획기(`ci-plan.mjs`)는 그대로이고, `retries` 와 무엇이 붉은가도 그대로다. 리포터는 알림과 job 요약에 수만 더한다. 그래도 조율자가 이 줄로 다시 보려면, 바뀐 것은 `playwright.config.ts` 의 `reporter` 한 줄과 새 파일 `playwright.flaky-reporter.ts` 뿐이다.

- [x] [끝났다는 것](docs/agents/delegation/done.md) — 돌리는 것은 `docs/agents/test-map.md`(차례에 「e2e 의 다시 돌리기」 절을 더함) · `docs/agents/test-map/kinds.md`(새 절)
- [x] 새 운영 절차 · 운영 SQL → 해당 없음
- [x] 새로 찾은 레퍼런스 → 해당 없음
- 역할 문서에 없어 헤맨 것: `feature.md` 는 시험만 고치는 일과 「일부러 어긴 것」을 재는 차례(옛 시험 사본을 옆에 두고 돌리기)를 가리키지 않는다 — `done.md` 「잠금이면 일부러 어긴 것」을 보고 따랐다.

## 사람이 할 걸음

없음. 머지 뒤 아무 PR 의 `anon` · `authed` job 요약에 「e2e 흔들림 N건」 줄이 서는지만 보면 된다(이 PR 의 CI 가 처음이다).

author: htuna07
body:
## Why
`nx@23.3.3`, the newest 23.x release, pins `undici` to exactly 7.29.0. Moving to nx 24 would be another major upgrade.

## Changes
Add one entry to the root `resolutions`:

```json
"undici@npm:7.29.0": "7.30.2"
```

7.30.2 is the version `testcontainers` already installs, so the tree now has a single `undici` copy.

**Removing it later:** the override only matches a request for exactly 7.29.0, so it stops applying once nx asks for another version. The entry can then be deleted.

## Audit
`yarn npm audit --all --recursive` (deprecation notices excluded):

| | Total | Critical | High | Moderate | Low |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Before | 100 | 2 | 38 | 51 | 9 |
| After | 82 | 2 | 32 | 42 | 6 |

All 18 removed advisories are `undici`. No new ones.

## Verification
nx only loads `undici` when an HTTP proxy is configured, so normal CI runs are not expected to exercise it. Tested locally by calling nx's HTTP client with `HTTP_PROXY` pointing at a local proxy: GET, POST, a streamed response and a 404 behaved as expected through the proxy. HTTPS targets and a real corporate proxy were not tested.

`yarn install --immutable`, `yarn nx sync:check` and a `database/testing` build pass.

author: charan2006-prog
body:
### Changes Made
- Implemented Google OAuth verifyCallback in `src/auth/passport.js`.
- Added returning user lookup using Google ID.
- Implemented verified email account linking.
- Added new user creation with the default member role.
- Implemented JWT issuance in the Google OAuth callback route.

### Questions

**1. Why does the check order (googleId → email → create) matter?**

Google ID is a permanent identifier, whereas email addresses can change. Checking Google ID first ensures returning users are correctly identified and prevents duplicate accounts.

**2. Why do you issue your own JWT instead of returning Google's accessToken?**

Google's access token is intended for accessing Google APIs. Our application needs its own JWT containing claims such as `sub` and `role`, with its own secret and expiration time.

Historical experiment for [flashinfer-ai/flashinfer#10036](https://github.com/flashinfer-ai/flashinfer/pull/10036) — merged upstream. **Do not merge this experiment.**

**Actual native [Bot Run Request Check](https://github.com/kangbintNV/flashinfer/runs/139944440345): `failure` / `command_missing`.**
[Real GitHub Actions run](https://github.com/kangbintNV/flashinfer/actions/runs/45830118316). The Check's github-actions App, completed state, conclusion and exact current head SHA were verified against the API. These are native Check Runs, not commit statuses.

Classification from the formal analysis: `gpu_required`.

- Checker PR flashinfer-ai/flashinfer#10020 is pinned at [`b53d126acf2ca62abff733af5525ebd522035750`](https://github.com/flashinfer-ai/flashinfer/commit/b53d126acf2ca62abff733af5525ebd522035750); all five checker-file hashes match. The actual `check_bot_run_request.run_pr` entry evaluates frozen original inputs; only historical I/O/publication is adapted.
- **No experimental exemption:** experimental GPU kernels, APIs and GPU tests require a genuine internal response just like other GPU changes. Documentation/CPU changes qualify only by GPU-independent behavior.
- Frozen comparison base `c743270f9d683faa524e115398c974f910a516ad` → head `d0cbb476cf4041a619523c325109b4d51f2a45f1`. Source bodies come from merged tree `628dd7c5c592d2e4a2556e0563b0c63ef32a4242`. `source/` preserves the original before/after snapshots; extra checker/harness changes are outside that subtree. Legacy merge-context differences are documented in the report and retain identical net patch edits.
- Original comments, actual account IDs/timestamps/URLs and file evidence: [`experiments/source.json`](https://github.com/kangbintNV/flashinfer/blob/5ca6a18bc7259aa719a192fcd41e93b96d9c5fea/experiments/source.json). Comment SHA256 `159aa84f7d3ee86cd3308207da0fc3b68c2dffdc19a92aa5c36e5d84d60c71c6`. Comments posted on this experimental PR are never evidence. No bot replies are impersonated.
- Historical internal responses qualify even if no pipeline started or passed. Public `@flashinfer-bot` responses do not qualify. Response shortcuts skip formal source/LLM analysis; the separate diagnostic explicitly withholds original comments.
- Compact JSON with default reasoning, then at most one minimal retry on failure/unknown. Minimal retry used: `True`. Original tests added by the PR are in scope; no corresponding selected case does not establish CPU-only behavior.
- Assistant static review expected `gpu_required`; formal assessment `correct_block`, classification assessment `match`. This is not independent maintainer annotation; pending review does not mean the Check itself is pending or unknown.
- Cohort: `fresh50`. Fixed source snapshots, original replies, old results and raw request/response evidence are retained for comparison.
- No GPU tests or `/bot run` commands were launched. Historical source is read as immutable Git blobs, never imported or executed. No PR comments/reactions, merges, repository-setting or branch-protection changes were made by this experiment. Required-check enforcement is not claimed.

[Full 150-case report](https://github.com/kangbintNV/flashinfer/blob/codex/bot-run-no-experimental-20261126/results/README.md) · [CSV](https://github.com/kangbintNV/flashinfer/blob/codex/bot-run-no-experimental-20261126/results/results.csv) · [Evidence archive](https://github.com/kangbintNV/flashinfer/blob/codex/bot-run-no-experimental-20261126/results/evidence-traces.zip)

## Summary

Replaces closed #1 (its branch was renamed to `test1`).

**`python/` — ML pipeline**
- Acquisition (`collect.py`, `occupancy.py record`), preprocessing (resample, Hampel, low-pass, AGC normalisation)
